propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherit generic 16,000-token / 600-second policy and make three structured-output retries before safe abstention, causing 216–311 second latencies with malformed oversized JSON responses.

RunRequest lacks operation-local bounds for output tokens, structured retries, transport attempts, and request timeout, violating documented advisory intent (story 9022, ADR 0086) to degrade promptly on timeout/error/malformation.

Applying output-token limits alone does not prevent retry loops; schema validation tightening occurs only after oversized payloads exist; latency containment requires concurrent timeout and retry-count bounds.

The repair introduces lowering-only seams in RunRequest for structured_retry, transport_attempts, and timeout_s; applies them in _effective_config before model construction; and requests 1,024 tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout for overlap judge.

All four overlap-local limits (token cap, structured retries, transport attempts, timeout) are necessary and sufficient to restore bounded abstention; removing any one bound restores original multi-generation failure mode.
